name: safegrd
description: Check SafeGrd backups, take one before a risky change and prove it restores, from Claude Code. No tool deletes, disables, re-routes or re-keys a backup.

safegrd_token.title: SafeGrd personal access token
safegrd_token.description: Create one in the SafeGrd console under Tokens (it starts with sg_pat_). The SafeGrd MCP server reads your backups and drills with it and can ask for a backup or a drill. It cannot delete, disable, re-route or re-key a backup.
